Title: 3 Habits Behind Bleeding Gums (It's Not Just Brushing)

Description:
Brushing and flossing perfectly, but your gums still bleed? The cause might not be in your bathroom cabinet at all - bleeding gums usually mean your immune system is already fighting inflammation, and three everyday habits can quietly fuel that fight.

Chronic stress, vaping, and not drinking enough water each play a role in gum inflammation and bleeding in their own way.

Watch to find out why, and the simple swaps that help.
